findings.F1: Across all six coins, a day's return scaled by its 20-day standard deviation is reversed the next day much more after weekend days than after weekdays: slope −0.00446 (t −5.03, n 4138) for weekend signal days against −0.00100 (t −2.29, n 10362) for weekday signal days.
findings.F2: Saturday reverses as strongly as Sunday, although the tested idea trades only Sunday. The next-day slope on the scaled move is −0.00459 (t −4.13, n 2069) after Saturday and −0.00438 (t −3.23, n 2069) after Sunday. Among weekdays, only Tuesday reaches that size, at −0.00344 (t −3.20).
findings.F3: Sunday's scaled move keeps being reversed beyond Monday. Over the next 3 days the slope is −0.00746 (t −3.48, n 2021, one Sunday a week, so no overlap), against −0.00438 over the next 1 day.
findings.F4: The reversal sits in high-volatility periods. With 20-day volatility measured against its own 120-day median, the next-day slope is +0.00069 (t 0.74) in the lowest tercile, −0.00126 (t −1.32) in the middle and −0.00274 (t −2.32) in the highest. On the non-overlapping 3-day grid the highest tercile gives −0.00932 (t −2.64, n 621), against +0.00332 in the lowest.
findings.F5: Inside the high-volatility tercile, the reversal is stronger on light-volume days, which is the brief's original volume direction and the opposite of the plan's supporting check. Day volume is measured against its 20-day average. The slope is −0.00775 (t −2.64, n 742) in the lowest-volume tercile, −0.00510 (t −2.03) in the middle and −0.00144 (t −0.82) in the heaviest.
findings.F6: The reversal comes from falls, not rises. On down days the next-day slope is −0.00314 (t −3.61, n 7151); on up days it is +0.00088 (t 1.12, n 7349). The lowest quintile of scaled moves is followed by +0.40% excess the next day (t 4.13, n 2894).
findings.F7: The Sunday reversal is not stable over time. It is strong in 2019 (−0.00748, t −3.03) and 2020 (−0.01099, t −3.00). It is near zero or positive in 2022 to 2024 (+0.0007, +0.0005, +0.0010). This matches the book's weak result: mean daily return 5.6e-05, Sharpe 0.16, all its gain booked on Mondays at +0.00080 a day.

ideas.idea: In a coin, Saturday's daily return measured in its 20-day daily standard deviations is reversed over the next 1 day: the larger Saturday's move, the larger Sunday's move against it.
ideas.consequence: After a large Saturday move, lean against it into Sunday, harder the larger the move.
ideas.name: Saturday move reverses Sunday

ideas.idea: In a coin, Sunday's daily return measured in its 20-day daily standard deviations is reversed over the next 3 days: the larger Sunday's move, the larger the move against it from Sunday's close to Wednesday's close.
ideas.consequence: Hold a lean against a large Sunday move through the first days of the week, not only into Monday.
ideas.name: Sunday move reverses midweek

ideas.idea: In a coin whose 20-day volatility is high against its own past 120 days, a day's return measured in its 20-day standard deviations is reversed over the next 1 day. The reversal is larger the lower that day's volume is against its 20-day average.
ideas.consequence: In turbulent periods, fade large daily moves made on light volume, and fade those made on heavy volume less.
ideas.name: Light-volume moves reverse in turbulence

ideas.idea: In a coin, a daily fall measured in its 20-day daily standard deviations is followed by a rebound over the next 1 day: the larger the scaled fall, the larger the next day's rise.
ideas.consequence: After a large scaled daily fall, lean long for the next day, larger the deeper the fall.
ideas.name: Scaled falls rebound next day
